title: DACH UMAS Content Loader technical input
description: Self-contained technical ingress union derived from the five current UMAS record schemas. Only id is required; all known source properties are optional here, nested presence/minimum collection sizes are relaxed, and unknown properties are forwarded. This does not validate complete source events, full-source update semantics, or DACH business rules. The DACH projection selects JOYN, JOYN_AT and JOYN_CH downstream.
